recommendations.title: Start with Wave 0: measure before you automate
recommendations.text: Inventory and classify the data of every system, and run process mining and time studies on 18 processes where better data is worth more than it costs. Wave 0 costs about $1.3M and takes about 3 months.

recommendations.title: Automate the highest-value processes first, integrating their data before automating
recommendations.text: The five largest are Sales: other work, stream 10 ($347.8M), Product and engineering: other work, stream 12 ($216.3M), Executive and strategy: other work, stream 2 ($197.2M), Product and engineering: other work, stream 5 ($196.5M), Product and engineering: other work, stream 9 ($158.1M), planning case values. 5 of them raise data readiness first.

recommendations.title: Move Service desk toward a two-part tariff as seats compress
recommendations.text: Migration value -$483.2M to $2.5B across the scenario values of the concession, cost, success and seat elasticity; it pays in 67% of those scenarios.

recommendations.title: Protect the path from junior to senior work
recommendations.text: Junior production work falls by more than half in 3 functions while review and sign-off stay senior. Keep junior roles in review rotations and training.
